title: Send Me Out
overview: A one-man reinterpretation of the acclaimed film Glengarry Glen Ross. Choosing the Icelandic countryside as the backdrop for the unraveling of events, the director Francisco Saco takes on the role of each character in the film, battling himself and the elements as he re-conceptualizes an emblematic American text on the pitfalls of patriarchy in an attempt to address his own torturous masculinity.
